item.description:
Redesigned progress cards and logo, smarter History, better re-encode quality, and download and layout fixes
## What's New - Download/Convert progress indicator is now a fixed-size status card - Updated the menu bar icon, popup, and sidebar to the app's drop logo - Added a button to refresh the clipboard preview on the Download tab - Added an analyze timeout and logging for analyze failures - Added a MISSING marker to History entries whose file was moved or deleted - Grouped repeated History entries into one row with a count and an expand toggle - Added a clear "not supported" message when Drop is opened on an Intel Mac - Added quality-tier subtext (4K Ultra HD, Full HD, etc) to the Download tab's resolution options - Added a re-encode indicator to Download's MOV option
## Changed - Improved re-encode quality with better VideoToolbox settings and a higher bitrate target - Bottom bar is now always visible - Removed Reveal in Finder from Download cards and Convert queue items - Improved tooltips and accessibility labels across the app - Matched the main top-bar button width across Download, Convert, and History
## Fixes - Fixed TikTok and other single-stream sources failing to download - Fixed the metadata VIDEO chip ignoring the re-encode selector - Fixed the window sometimes refusing to shrink back to its minimum height - Fixed failed downloads sometimes missing the last line of their error message - Fixed partial files being left in the download folder when quitting during a download
